description: Converts a validated bounded network-map manifest and referenced GeoJSON into a browser-renderable map Artifact.
responsibilities: Read only the bounded indonesia_network_map.v1 manifest and verify its exact GeoJSON Resource identity.
Pass the unchanged GeoJSON reference, Mapbox layers and safe extensions to map_utils.create_map_card.
Publish and explicitly embed the returned map.v3 Artifact without recalculating or changing network evidence.
risks: A valid map shows supplied evidence but does not independently validate the underlying decision.
Changing layers or source references can misrepresent the analytical comparison.
